test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the following statements and mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): Peer Ali Khan was executed during the 1857 Revolt.

Reason (R) : He was a British informant who switched sides during the uprising.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A is true, but R is false.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Peer Ali Khan was a revolutionary freedom fighter in the 1857 Revolt, actively opposing British rule in India.
 
• He was one of the key leaders of the uprising in Patna, Bihar, and secretly organized anti-British activities.
 
• He was executed by the British in 1857 due to his involvement in the revolt and his resistance against colonial rule.
 
• The claim that Peer Ali Khan was a British informant is false; he was, in fact, a staunch opponent of British imperialism.
 
• Pee
